name: Tag input
summary: A field where each value typed becomes a removable tag.
description:
Use a tag input for a short, open list: skills, keywords, email recipients. For a fixed set of choices, checkboxes or a multi-select are clearer.

Without JS it is a plain text field that takes comma-separated values. data-v-tag-input turns the value into tags and moves the field's name to a hidden input holding the same comma-separated value, so the server needs no changes. Enter or a comma adds, a pasted list adds each item, Backspace in the empty field removes the last tag, and each tag has its own remove button.

classes.name: v-tag-input
classes.description: The wrapper around one .v-input. Once the JS runs it draws the field box that holds the tags and the input.

classes.name: v-tag-input-list
classes.description: The list of tags, added by the JS, labelled with the field's label and the count.

classes.name: v-tag-input-field
classes.description: The text input inside the box. The JS swaps .v-input for this class so no direction styles it as a second field.

states.description: On the wrapper: the character that ends a tag and joins the form value (default ",").
On the wrapper: the most tags allowed.
On the wrapper: the announced and button words, with {tag} for the value (defaults "{tag} added", "{tag} removed", "Remove {tag}").
Set by the JS once it has taken over the field.

hooks.name: data-v-tag-input
hooks.description: Turns the field's value into tags, keeps the form value in a hidden input with the same name, and announces each change.

events.name: v:tags
events.description: Fires whenever the list changes, with every tag in order.

keyboard.action: Adds what was typed as a tag. An empty Enter submits the form as usual.
In the empty field, removes the last tag.
Moves through each tag's remove button and the field. Leaving the field keeps a half-typed value as a tag.

a11y: Each added or removed tag is announced in a polite live region, since nothing else tells a screen reader the list changed.
Each remove button is labelled "Remove Roofing", not just an x.
The label stays on the real input, so the field keeps its name and hint.

examples.title: Skills
examples.description: Add a skill with Enter or a comma, remove one with its button.
examples.html: Up to 8. Press Enter or a comma after each.
